ideas.pitch: A supply chain provenance platform using verifiable zero-knowledge proofs and hardware telemetry to track sensitive shipments without leaking proprietary supplier metadata.
ideas.problem_statement: Supply Chain, Logistics & Product Authenticity Security
ideas.title: SecureTrail
ideas.track: Supply Chain, Logistics & Product Authenticity Security
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the mandated security integration requirement by applying cryptographic supply-chain security, appealing heavily to the evaluation criteria of government and institutional judges like MeitY and ISEA.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first emergency disaster response communication node utilizing ESP32 LoRa and BLE mesh networks with automated end-to-end encrypted packet routing.
ideas.problem_statement: Environment, Disaster Management & Disaster Response Security
ideas.title: ResilientMesh Guard
ideas.track: Environment, Disaster Management & Disaster Response Security
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven hardware-software mesh patterns that guarantee a working live demo during judging even if internet connectivity drops, scoring high on field-deployable utility.

ideas.pitch: An explainable anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation dashboard combining transaction graph intelligence with localized gradient-boosted models.
ideas.title: FinGraph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the enterprise focus of sponsors like Temenos by solving financial fraud detection with transparent, explainable machine learning outputs tailored for institutional compliance.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge patient data privacy gateway allowing medical researchers to query sensitive health databases securely without exposing patient personally identifiable information.
ideas.title: MediVault ZK
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles strict regulatory privacy compliance head-on using modern cryptographic proofs, impressing judges who prioritize data sovereignty and patient confidentiality.

ideas.pitch: An edge AI anomaly detection system for critical energy substation infrastructure that flags SCADA network intrusions and physical safety violations locally.
ideas.title: GridShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on national critical infrastructure protection—a primary objective of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and ISEA security initiatives.
